description: This file implements a layout test runner and worker system for running web platform tests, including sharding, test execution, and result handling.

classes.name: TestRunInterruptedException
classes.description: Exception raised to stop a test run immediately.

classes.name: LayoutTestRunner
classes.description: Main class managing the execution of layout tests, including sharding, running, and result collection.

classes.name: Worker
classes.description: Represents a worker process that executes a list of tests.

classes.name: TestShard
classes.description: Represents a shard of tests, with a name and list of test inputs.

classes.name: Sharder
classes.description: Handles dividing tests into shards based on various strategies.

methods.name: run_tests
methods.description: Runs the set of tests with given expectations, handling sharding and retries.

methods.name: _worker_factory
methods.description: Creates a Worker instance for a given connection.

methods.name: _mark_interrupted_tests_as_skipped
methods.description: Marks tests that were not completed as skipped due to interruption.

methods.name: _interrupt_if_at_failure_limits
methods.description: Checks failure limits and raises interruption if limits are exceeded.

methods.name: _update_summary_with_result
methods.description: Updates test results summary and prints results.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Dispatches messages to internal handlers based on message name.

methods.name: _handle_started_test
methods.description: Handles notification that a test has started.

methods.name: _handle_finished_test_list
methods.description: Handles notification that a test list has finished.

methods.name: _handle_finished_test
methods.description: Handles notification that a test has finished and updates results.

methods.name: _handle_device_failed
methods.description: Handles notification that a device has failed during testing.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the Worker object.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Prepares the worker for running tests, establishing drivers.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles test list execution, running each test.

methods.name: _update_test_input
methods.description: Lazy loads reference files and determines if pixel tests should run.

methods.name: _run_test
methods.description: Runs a single test, posts start and finish messages, and cleans up.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Cleans up drivers.

methods.name: _kill_driver
methods.description: Stops a driver if it exists.

methods.name: _clean_up_after_test
methods.description: Handles post-test cleanup, including driver restarts on failure.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes a TestShard with name and test inputs.

methods.name: __repr__
methods.description: String representation of a TestShard.

methods.name: __eq__
methods.description: Equality comparison for TestShard.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes a Sharder with test split function and max locked shards.

methods.name: shard_tests
methods.description: Divides tests into shards based on number of workers and parallelism options.

methods.name: _shard_in_two
methods.description: Creates two shards: one requiring lock, one not.

methods.name: _shard_every_file
methods.description: Creates a shard per test file for maximum parallelism.

methods.name: _shard_by_directory
methods.description: Creates shards grouped by directory.

methods.name: _resize_shards
methods.description: Reduces number of shards by redistributing tests.
